answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. The island holds work receipts rather than names, so the willow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
